analyst.summary: Kaveri Seed is a financially strong, debt-free hybrid-seed company (cotton, maize, rice, vegetables) with high returns on capital and rising promoter ownership, but multi-year revenue growth has been structurally muted by long-standing government price controls on cotton hybrid seeds. Growth has picked up over the last year, likely helped by non-cotton crop diversification, but working-capital days have also risen and the tax rate looks unusually low, both worth watching. We rate this a Hold.
